full_details: Master Thwaite preached once, because the churchwardens had spoken, and he would not say it again at evening prayer. Sir John sat his pew and did not speak. There was no sword-bearer. You played Egeon at two. The share was thirty-five shillings, received, and Christmas stayed a blank with no sum. Monday is the Navarre comedy, and you are in it. Thursday is the king again, and you are in it. At supper Mistress Ansell said the bells had been stopped, and she did not say she missed them. Her husband has been dead six years at Hallowtide. She boils his ink every Monday by his receipt. The horn is the old horn, and she boils the new on Monday. Verbeke said Ghent remembered both ways in one street, and it went ill, and he went out by the north door. Master Thwaite heard him and did not take it up. You were asked nothing, and you said nothing. The one page is still one page.
one_sentence: You heard one glass, took thirty-five shillings, and sat supper while she spoke of the bells and the ink.
title: One glass, and thirty-five shillings
